metadata.title: Variational mean curvatures for general $\mathrm{C}^{1,α}$ domains
metadata.abstract: The notion of variational mean curvature (VMC) arises from Massari's variational approach to hypersurfaces of prescribed mean curvature and expresses a minimizing property for Massari's functional. Here, we complement the theory of VMCs with a new sharp relation between hypersurface regularity and VMC integrability. In fact, our main result asserts that every bounded open set in $\mathbb{R}^n$ with $\mathrm{C}^{1,\alpha}$ boundary, $0<\alpha<1$, has a global VMC in $\mathrm{L}^p(\mathbb{R}^n)$ for every $p<\frac{1+\alpha}{1-\alpha}$. In addition, we underpin sharpness of this conclusion by constructing examples of bounded open sets in $\mathbb{R}^n$ with $\mathrm{C}^{1,\alpha}$ boundary which do not admit a VMC in $\mathrm{L}^p(\mathbb{R}^n)$ for any $p>\frac{1+\alpha}{1-\alpha}$. Our proofs are based on Barozzi's level-set construction of global VMCs and determine integrability of these VMCs by geometric investigation of their superlevel sets and of related unions of balls.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 证明每个有界 C^{1,α} 区域都具有全局 L^p 变分平均曲率，其中 p<(1+α)/(1−α)，并构造超过该阈值时不存在此类曲率的例子。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出边界 Hölder 正则性与变分曲率可积性的锐联系。
analysis.limitations: 摘要的存在与反例分别使用严格不等号，临界指数不能自动纳入；讨论的是变分曲率。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 可用于弱平均曲率与几何变分中的精确假设选择。
